annotations.title: Get Goofish Seller Profile & Zhima Credit

description: Audit a Goofish (Xianyu) seller's Zhima Credit rating (芝麻信用), biometric KYC badges, response rate, historical sold count, and objective 0-100 trust score.

includeItems.description: Include active storefront listings inline in the profile response.

includeReviews.description: Include recent buyer transaction reviews inline in the profile response.

maxItems.description: Maximum inline listings to return when includeItems is true (1-20, default 10).

maxReviews.description: Maximum inline buyer reviews to return when includeReviews is true (1-20, default 10).

sellerIdOrUrl.description: Seller numeric userId, goofish.com profile or item URL, m.tb.cn share link, or fleamarket:// deeplink.

name: get_goofish_seller_profile
